Name: Ginger Island Survival
Author: IamWENJI
Description:
[b]Description[/b] You don't start on a farm. You wake up stranded on Ginger Island with nothing but a washed-up crate. Survive, explore, and earn your way back to the mainland — the hard way.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0+ and Custom Farm Loader[/*]
[*]Extract both folders from the ZIP into your Stardew Valley Mods/ directory[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b] Wake up on Ginger Island beach instead of the farmhouse. Start with only a basic survival crate. Sleep on the island and wake up there the next morning. Earn a return ticket to the mainland through gameplay.
[b]Requirements[/b] SMAPI 4.0+ and Custom Farm Loader (CFL) by DeLiXx
